communication_goal: 筛选必要上下文，避免无关信息干扰当前任务。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left of a small desk and points toward a large desktop monitor at center. The monitor has a clear rectangular bezel and a fully blank black inner screen, outlined in white. Show the whole inner screen unobstructed; keep the pointing hand outside the bezel. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. A small pile of blank papers rests aside at the far left of the desk, representing unnecessary context, away from the monitor. No writing, symbols or UI text.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图文字。显示器内屏完整，指手不遮主体；额外键盘、鼠标与纸堆不参与教学，只框内屏。 准确无扩张裁剪发现初稿右/下缘过紧，已按1254原图像素位置重新归一化并保留小余量；不改变词义与对象指代。
